subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should configured deferred-maintenance timeouts preserve the existing one-in-flight `ContextEngine.maintain()` behavior, or should OpenClaw intentionally make re-entrant same-session maintenance a supported plugin SDK contract?
rationale: This determines the durable public plugin contract and cannot be safely selected by a local fence: host-side fencing cannot serialize or repair plugin-owned state.

options.title: Preserve single-flight maintenance
options.body: Keep an invocation barrier or coalescing path so a timed-out call cannot overlap a later same-session `maintain()` call.

options.title: Adopt re-entrant maintenance
options.body: Explicitly accept concurrent same-session calls as a supported SDK behavior, with owner approval, compatibility communication, and proof against representative external engines.

recommendation.title: Preserve single-flight maintenance
recommendation.body: Keep an invocation barrier or coalescing path so a timed-out call cannot overlap a later same-session `maintain()` call.

likelyOwner.reason: The author documented and implemented the proposed contract change and can provide the immediate design context; final acceptance should be made by the relevant plugin/runtime owner.
